name: Schottky diode (1N5819)
description: A Schottky diode: like a normal diode (current from anode A to cathode K, the grey band) but it drops only about 0.3 V, so less power is lost. Used in power supplies, for reverse-polarity protection and as a fast flyback diode. Blocks up to 40 V, carries up to 1 A.
